schema_fix.invalidated_revisions_foreign_key: (decision_id, task_id, revision) REFERENCES task_decisions(decision_id, task_id, revision), in addition to the TaskSpec composite foreign key.
schema_fix.kind_guard: A SQLite BEFORE INSERT trigger permits invalidation only when the linked decision kind is cancelled or revoked.
schema_fix.legacy_migration: Schema v1 is transactionally rebuilt to schema v2. Existing rows are copied under the new composite constraint; invalid legacy links abort and roll back the migration. Valid cancellation history and revision invalidation survive reopen.

independent_failure_before_after.before: RepositoryInvariantTests.test_database_invalidation_cannot_reference_another_tasks_authority_decision failed: SQLite accepted Task A/revision 1 invalidation linked to Task B scope approval.
independent_failure_before_after.after: The unchanged independent test passes. A worker-owned control inserts an unused revoked decision for Task B, which passes the invalidation-kind trigger, then attempts to attach it to Task A; the composite foreign key rejects the cross-Task/revision link. A second direct-SQL control confirms a same-Task non-terminal decision kind is rejected by the trigger.

checks.summary: 20 tests, including all 9 independent test_designer cases, cross-Task invalidation rejection, invalidation-kind guard, schema v1 migration, and reopen/rollback cases.

remaining_gaps: Migration tests cover a valid schema v1 database with durable cancellation history; corrupt legacy data is expected to fail migration atomically but is not separately fault-injected in this correction.
This correction does not add concurrent-writer or power-loss recovery claims.
